newsitem.title: USA: Culp gets $125 mln bank credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Culp gets $125 mln bank credit facility.

text.p: Culp Inc said Thursday it had obtained a $125 million credit facility from a syndicate of banks led by Wachovia Bank of North Carolina N.A. and First Union National Bank of North Carolina.
The new facility, which replaces Culp's $66 million credit line, will reduce interest costs and allow less restrictive conditions, Culp, the largest maker of upholstery products in the world, said.
Robert Cup III, chief executive officer, said that facility, plus proceeds of $16.3 million from a secondary offering of stock in January, will bolster the company's finances.
"Our intent is to capitalize on these resources to support Culp's ongoing internal expansion as well as our interest in complementing this growth through other strategic acqusitions," he said.
